items.content_html:
nhlt-dmic-info is a tool to extract microphone array information from the ACPI NHLT table.

Although part of the alsa-utils source tree it is completely independent and has no dependencies beyond the C standard library.

By building it separately, we enable its use in alsa-ucm-conf (cf. #392058 (comment)) without creating a circular dependency. The usual autoconf‐/automake‐based build flow is circumvented to avoid unnecessary dependency on alsa-lib.

The version and src attributes are inherited from alsa-utils to ease maintenance.

error: Querying Python at `/home/username/.local/share/uv/python/cpython-3.13.5-linux-x86_64-gnu/bin/python3.13` failed with exit status exit status: 127

[stderr]
Could not start dynamically linked executable: /home/username/.local/share/uv/python/cpython-3.13.5-linux-x86_64-gnu/bin/python3.13
NixOS cannot run dynamically linked executables intended for generic
linux environments out of the box. For more information, see:
https://nix.dev/permalink/stub-ld

items.content_html:
This removes the previously deprecated NIXOS_EXTRA_MODULE_PATH environment variable.
Related to #349549

Tested with

$ nix-instantiate nixos/lib/eval-config.nix --arg modules '[{fileSystems."/".device="x";boot.loader.grub.enable=false;}]' -A config.system.build.toplevel 
$ NIXOS_EXTRA_MODULE_PATH=$HOME/whatever.nix nix-instantiate nixos/lib/eval-config.nix --arg modules '[{fileSystems."/".device="x";boot.loader.grub.enable=false;}]' -A config.system.build.toplevel

This option has been previously deprecated and should be removed for release 25.05 according to the comments.
I have also added this change in the changelog, since the next release will be one year after the deprecation of this functionality and I removed the evaluation warnings.
